name: Copy trading with forensic and statistical wallet screening
one_line: Mirror a small set of slow-conviction wallets detected on-chain in 2-3 s, selected by randomisation-null skill tests rather than leaderboard PnL, with exit mirroring.
scope: Cover selection (sign-randomisation null: 3.14% skilled, 44% retain status out of sample; Wilson intervals; 6,365 wallets to 72 passed; rolling-accuracy vs PnL ranking; weak monthly persistence), detection (OrderFilled websocket vs REST polling), gate stack and exit engine, measured copy differential (+1.62 pp vs own trades), which leaders are uncopyable (latency edges, maker-earned edges, split/hedged wallets, liquidity sweepers), realised small-bankroll results (+$256.85 on $500) and failures (1 s late copy of swisstony, vendor figure 67% underperform), migration breakage (pUSD, CLOB V2), bait risk from the ghost-fill era. Boundary: following anomalous fresh wallets is informed-flow-and-insider-trading; selling copy bots is builder-code-routing-business; fading bad wallets is speculative band.
sub_variants: on-chain event-level mirror with exit engine

academic: Copy trading with a statistically validated skill filter
flags: Many third-party copy bots are custodial or outright drainers; never run researched bot repos.

critic_notes: MOVE 'thin-book front-running of market orders' and 'selling into copy-followers' out of ghost-fills-bot-hunting, which should stay a pure settlement-atomicity threat model, into the proposed builder-tagged-flow-and-follower-flow entry (or, if that entry is rejected, into screened-copy-trading as a hazard section).

COUNT: the five proposed entries would take the band to 32. To stay near the target, send perps-lp-rewards-basis to the speculative band, keep builder-tagged flow as a sub-variant of event-market-making-spread-carry plus screened-copy-trading if no PnL evidence turns up, and fold tech-ai-model-markets' manipulation part into oracle-input-manipulation's fragility taxonomy. news-event-feed-latency-taking, genesis-window-new-listing-liquidity and oracle-governance-capture should be files.

screened-copy-trading is not weak as a file but its positive evidence is thin and the market is shrinking: +1.62 pp measured uplift (abstract), one $500 account, one paper experiment netting +$171, and copy-bot volume down 77% Apr-Aug 2026 with 1.6-2.0% all-in entry cost on bot-routed fills (E6). The file should lead with those numbers rather than with the build.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: On-chain copy-trading with forensic wallet screening
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Detect target wallets' fills from Polygon OrderFilled events in 2-3 s, mirror through safety gates, and mirror their exits too.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: A dual feed (on-chain websocket ~2-3 s; REST fallback 30-60 s) spots fills by screened wallets; a gate stack (price band, slippage, per-whale and per-topic caps, liquidity, minimum exit size) decides whether to send a FAK taker order; an exit engine mirrors whale sells plus TP/SL/time decay; resolved positions are auto-claimed. Screening is the core: 6,365 leaderboard wallets -> 72 passed (3.1%) using Wilson intervals on win rate, open-risk caps and bot/dust filters. Result: +$256.85 realised on a $500 bankroll in ~5 weeks. Works only on slow-conviction whales - the best one's whole edge was 1-3c lottery tickets - and fails on latency-edge accounts.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Free-riding on a minority of genuinely informed, slow traders; on-chain transparency.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Most copy tools poll REST and copy leaderboard names; event-level detection plus exit mirroring removes the two largest leaks.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Whales move thin books 3-8c before you arrive; insiders sweep all liquidity; whales hedge across wallets; 67% of copy traders underperform the wallet they copy (vendor figure); a commercial copy bot lost 23% in one review; survivorship in leaderboards; collateral/API migrations (pUSD, CLOB v2) break bots.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Shadow-copy 20 screened wallets for a month with recorded fillable prices at +3 s; compare shadow PnL to the whales' PnL and attribute the gap.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Many third-party copy bots are custodial or outright drainers (see service-business candidate).

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Copy trading with a statistically validated skill filter
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Select leaders by a sign-randomisation skill test and rolling out-of-sample accuracy rather than leaderboard PnL, and size by the measured copy-vs-own differential (~1.6 pts).
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: For every wallet with >=10 events, randomise trade directions 10,000 times at event level to get a null PnL distribution; keep wallets whose realised PnL is in the extreme tail, then re-test on a held-out period (44% retain the label). Copy only in markets where the leader acts as maker or early taker and where your entry slippage is smaller than the documented differential. Track decay: monthly performance persistence is weak in the broad population.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: A small persistent skilled minority on a transparent ledger.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Leaderboards are dominated by luck and by one-shot insiders; the randomisation null removes both.

evidence.title: The Return to Imitation: Evidence from Copy Trading on Polymarket (Oliphant), SSRN via Crossref abstract
evidence.supports: Copy trades outperform a follower's own non-copy trades in the same market by 1.62 percentage points.

evidence.title: Per-Market Information Leakage and Order-Flow Skill (Nechepurenko) - summarising the account-level sign-randomisation study
evidence.supports: 1.72M accounts, 210,322 markets, $13.76B (2023-2025): 3.14% of accounts with >=10 events are 'skilled winners' capturing >30% of platform gains; 44% of those classified skilled in training retain the label on held-out data.

evidence.title: Who Wins and Who Loses in Prediction Markets? (Akey, Gregoire, Harvie, Martineau), SSRN via Crossref abstract
evidence.supports: Top 1% capture 76.5% of gains, but monthly performance shows weak persistence - 'heterogeneous conditions rather than persistent skill'.

evidence.title: Skilled Liquidity Provision in Prediction Markets (Yang), SSRN via Crossref abstract
evidence.supports: Top-5% by rolling historical accuracy persist out-of-sample and earn on both maker and taker sides - skill classification by accuracy, not PnL.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: 1.62 pts is smaller than typical copy slippage in thin markets; skilled wallets earn much of their edge as makers, which cannot be copied; leaders split across wallets; conflicting persistence evidence; ghost-fill era showed copy bots being baited.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Walk-forward: classify on months 1-12, paper-copy months 13-15 with realistic delay (next block + your latency) and book-walking slippage; compare with copying the raw PnL leaderboard.
